paragraphs: Unless otherwise stated in this Annual Report, references to "AppFolio," "we," "us," and "our" refer to AppFolio, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries.

Founded in 2006, AppFolio is a technology leader powering the future of real estate. We provide a cloud-based platform, the AppFolio Platform, on which our customers operate their businesses. Our primary customers are property management companies who manage a variety of property types, including single family, multifamily, affordable, commercial, student, and community associations. We help our customers navigate an increasingly interconnected and growing network of stakeholders in their business ecosystems, including property managers, property investors, potential residents, residents, and vendors. We also provide key functionality related to critical transactions across the real estate lifecycle, including screening potential residents, sending and receiving payments, and providing insurance-related risk mitigation services. Our services enable our customers to connect communities, increase operational efficiency, deliver exceptional customer experiences, and improve financial and operational performance. We believe our customer-centric culture leads to long-term customer retention and, ultimately, our long-term success.

Our mission is to build the platform where real estate comes to do business. The AppFolio Platform is designed to deliver value to industry stakeholders throughout the property management ecosystem. These stakeholders include property managers, property owners and investors, residents, and vendors. Our performance-driven platform is (i) a system of record to centralize and store all critical operating information, (ii) a system of action to automate complex workflows while delivering improved outcomes, and (iii) a system of growth to drive value and revenue for the entire ecosystem.

The AppFolio Platform is built upon a unified architecture designed to serve as a single secure system of record for our customers' operational and financial data. This platform foundation provides real-time business intelligence and accounting functionality while maintaining data integrity. Building upon this foundation, AppFolio Realm integrates artificial intelligence, or AI, directly into the platform's workflows. Through features such as Realm, the platform is capable of automating repetitive, high-volume tasks and promoting operational efficiency. To further enhance the platform's versatility, the AppFolio Stack™ marketplace utilizes application programming interfaces, or APIs, to facilitate our customers' ability to integrate specialized, third-party technology and services. This extensible ecosystem allows customers and partners to customize their workflows and incorporate specialized external solutions into the unified AppFolio environment.

We categorize our products and services into two categories, Subscription Services and Value Added Services. Utilization and adoption of our Subscription Services and Value Added Services is typically higher for residential properties than community association or commercial properties because of the unique and complex needs of the residential rental lifecycle.
The AppFolio Platform is primarily offered via three Subscription Plans: Core, Plus, and Max.

•AppFolio Property Manager Core. AppFolio Property Manager Core is generally suited for small property management companies, serving as the basic, comprehensive, all-in-one system of record centered on accounting functionality, and includes access to a limited set of Stack™ integrations.

•AppFolio Property Manager Plus. AppFolio Property Manager Plus is designed for more complex, growing property management businesses, expanding on the Core plan functionality by adding capabilities for affordable housing and student housing, advanced accounting, advanced data analysis, and read-only API access, along with access to all Stack™ integrations.

•AppFolio Property Manager Max. AppFolio Property Manager Max includes the functionality of Plus and adds functionality designed for our largest operators, offering tools such as end-to-end leasing support with built-in leasing customer relationship management, or CRM, and leasing signals, and provides full database access through a read/write API.
The Subscription Services AppFolio offers are provided through the Core, Plus, and Max Subscription Plans or can be added as ancillary functionality. Key services offered include:

•Accounting and Reporting. AppFolio provides property management accounting software that acts as a single system of record, capturing every transaction in one centralized database. The software utilizes AI-powered features, such as Smart Budgeting, Bank Feed, Bill Approval Flows, and Smart Bill Entry to reduce manual data entry and increase reporting accuracy. Performance Insights dashboards enables data-driven strategic decision-making and efficient financial management.

•Marketing and Leasing. The marketing and leasing tools are designed to help customers maximize occupancy, maintain a leasing pipeline, and manage the fully integrated lead-to-lease process. Our Realm Leasing Performer leverages AI to automate prospect engagement, including lead qualification, data capture, and tour scheduling. These capabilities are integrated with our Leasing CRM, which provides centralized end-to-end leasing management and conversion tracking. For portfolio optimization, our Leasing Signals supports customers' pricing decisions using their own unique pricing strategies and provides explainable pricing suggestions based on public data.

•Maintenance. The platform provides property maintenance tools through automation and online maintenance workflows. Our Realm Maintenance Performer utilizes AI to automate service request intake and triage. The tool facilitates real-time, multi-lingual communication with residents and automatically generates prioritized work orders. This automation is designed to reduce response times and streamline the resolution of maintenance issues. Our Unit Turn Board allows customers to track and manage the tasks required to prepare a unit for new occupancy, with the goal of minimizing vacancy periods and optimizing rental income.

•Communication and Service. AppFolio provides modern communication tools to streamline customer service, maintain operations, and create seamless experiences for residents, property owners, and investors. Our Realm Messages integrates text and email communications into a centralized inbox. This feature allows customers to manage resident correspondence within the platform's core workflow, which is designed to improve record-keeping and response efficiency.

headings: Risks Related to Our Products and Services
If we are found to be in violation of the legal requirements applicable to our products and services, our business and operating results may be adversely affected.
We face risks in our electronic payment services business that could adversely affect our business and/or results of operations.
Changes to payment card networks or bank fees, rules, or practices could harm our business.
We face risks in our tenant screening services business that could adversely affect our business and/or operating results.
Our resident-focused offerings, such as Resident Onboarding and Resident Onboarding Lift, subject us and our customers to increased regulatory scrutiny and legal requirements.
We could face antitrust challenges, which could harm our business and operating results.

If we are unable to deliver effective customer service, it could harm our relationships with our existing customers and adversely affect our ability to attract new customers and our operating results.
If our property management customers stop requiring insurance coverage for their units, our operating results could be harmed.
The development and incorporation of AI in our services may result in reputational harm or liability, which could adversely affect our business and operating results.
If we are unable to ensure that our products and services keep pace with other technology, we may become less competitive and our operating results may be harmed.
If we are unable to ensure that our products and services interoperate with other technology, we may become less competitive and our operating results may be harmed.
We rely upon third-party service providers to host our platform and any disruption of such third-party services would impact our operations and our business could be adversely impacted.
Risks Related to Cybersecurity and Data Privacy
Privacy laws and regulations could impose additional costs and reduce demand for our services.
Risks Related to Attracting and Retaining Talent

Our corporate culture has contributed to our success and, if we cannot continue to preserve this culture, we could lose the passion, creativity, teamwork, focus and innovation fostered by our culture.

All of our revenues are presently generated by sales to customers in the real estate industry, and factors that adversely affect that industry, or our customers within it, could also adversely affect us.
Our estimates of market opportunity are subject to significant uncertainty.
Risks Related to Growing Our Business
Our inability to effectively maintain and enhance our brands could adversely affect our ability to attract new customers and negatively affect our business and operating results.
If we fail to manage our growth effectively, our costs and operating expenses may increase without corresponding increases in revenue, which would adversely affect our operating results.

If we do not accurately predict and respond promptly to rapidly evolving technological developments and customer needs, the demand for our products and our business and operating results may be harmed.
We participate in an intensely competitive market and our business could be harmed if we do not compete effectively.
If we are unable to successfully expand sales of our products and services to new markets, our business, financial condition, and operating results may suffer.

Our business depends substantially on existing customers renewing their subscriptions with us and expanding their use of our Value Added Services, and a decline in either could adversely affect our operating results.
We manage our business to achieve long-term growth, which may not be consistent with the short-term expectations of some investors.
Our acquisition of other companies or technologies may subject us to risks.
Risks Related to Intellectual Property Matters
Failure to protect our intellectual property rights, including our code, proprietary technology and brands, could impair our competitive position and harm our business.
paragraphs: Investing in our securities involves risks. You should consider carefully the risks described below, together with all of the other information included in this Annual Report, as well as in our other filings with the SEC, in evaluating our business and/or an investment in our Class A common stock. If any of the following risks actually occur, our business, financial condition, operating results, cash flows and prospects could be materially and adversely affected. In that case, the trading price of our Class A common stock may decline and you might lose all or part of your investment. The risks described below are not the only risks we face. Additional risks that we currently do not know about or that we currently believe to be immaterial may also impair our business, financial condition, operating results, cash flows, and prospects.

Our business activities are subject to various federal, state and local laws and regulations. In addition, certain of our services, such as our tenant screening and risk mitigation services, are highly regulated or intended to be used in connection with other highly regulated activities. Unfavorable laws, regulations, and administrative or judicial decisions interpreting or applying laws and regulations could subject us to litigation or governmental investigation and increase our cost of doing business, any of which may adversely affect our operating results. Further, the evolution and expansion of our products and services may subject us to additional regulatory risks and requirements. For example, as our electronic payments services business evolves, we may become directly subject to laws governing money transmission and anti-money laundering. Regulatory requirements vary throughout the markets in which we operate, and have increased over time as the scope and complexity of our products and services have expanded. Moreover, federal and state legislatures and regulatory agencies have indicated they are focused on protecting tenants. This focus may result in the introduction of new laws and regulations that are directly applicable to our business. There is no guarantee that we will not be subject to fines, criminal and civil lawsuits or other regulatory enforcement actions in one or more jurisdictions or be required to adjust business practices to accommodate regulatory requirements.

New and evolving regulatory requirements may also impact our customers and their ability or willingness to utilize our products and services. For instance, we consistently monitor regulatory activity by the Federal Trade Commission (the "FTC"), by the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau ("CFPB"), and by various state regulatory bodies applicable to tenant screening. New or uncertain regulatory requirements may impact our ability to offer or our customers' ability and willingness to utilize certain of our services, which may impact our operating results.

We periodically undergo examinations, audits, and investigations by regulatory authorities related to our services, including those related to the affairs of insurance companies and agencies and electronic payment services providers. Such examining, auditing, and investigating regulatory authorities are generally vested with relatively broad discretion to grant, renew and revoke licenses and approvals, to implement and interpret rules and regulations, levy fines and penalties, and bring enforcement actions. While we have implemented various programs, processes and controls focused on compliance with applicable laws and regulations throughout our business, there is no guarantee that we will not be subject to fines, penalties or other regulatory actions in one or more jurisdictions, or be required to adjust our business practices to accommodate future regulatory requirements. In the event that we are found to be in violation of our legal or regulatory requirements, we may be subject to monetary fines or penalties, cease-and-desist orders, mandatory product changes, or other liabilities that could have an adverse effect on our business (including damage to our reputation) and operating results.

Our electronic payment services business facilitates the processing of inbound and outbound payments for our customers. These payments are settled through our sponsoring clearing bank, licensed money transmitters, card payment processors and other third-party electronic payment services providers that we contract with from time to time. With respect to these service providers, we have significantly less control over the systems and processes than if we were to maintain and operate those systems and processes ourselves. In some cases, functions necessary to our business are performed on proprietary third-party systems and software to which we have no access. We also generally do not have long-term contracts with these service providers. Moreover, we rely on a limited number of third-party electronic payment services providers and, in some instances, do not have a backup provider in place for a specific service. Accordingly, the failure of these service providers to renew their contracts with us or to fulfill their contractual obligations and perform satisfactorily could result in significant disruptions to our operations and adversely affect our operating results.

We are, and will continue to be, subject to risks arising from or related to the settlement of payment transactions, including with respect to prefunding and chargeback requests as well as human or processing errors. paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition, results of operations and liquidity should be read together with our Consolidated Financial Statements and the related notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report.

The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations includes 2025 and 2024 items and year-over-year comparisons between 2025 and 2024. For discussion of 2023 items and year-over-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023, refer to Part II. Item 7. "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024. Our Consolidated Financial Statements are prepared and presented in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States ("GAAP"). This Annual Report also contains information regarding our non-GAAP income from operations ("Non-GAAP operating income") and non-GAAP operating margin ("Non-GAAP Operating Margin"), each of which constitutes a non-GAAP financial measure. We use these non-GAAP financial measures in addition to, and not as a substitute for, or superior to, financial measures calculated in accordance with GAAP. For more information regarding these non-GAAP financial measures, refer to "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations - Non-GAAP Financial Measures" below.

We are a technology leader powering the future of real estate. We provide a cloud-based platform on which our customers operate their businesses. We help our customers navigate an increasingly interconnected and growing network of stakeholders in their business ecosystems, including property managers, property investors, potential residents, residents, and vendors. We also provide key functionality related to critical transactions across the real estate lifecycle, including screening potential residents, sending and receiving payments, and providing insurance-related risk mitigation services. Our services enable our customers to connect communities, increase operational efficiency, deliver exceptional customer experiences, and improve financial and operational performance.
Financial Highlights for the Fiscal Year 2025
•Total property management units under management grew 8% year-over-year to 9.4 million.
•Revenue grew 20% year-over-year to $950.8 million.
•GAAP operating income was $152.9 million, or 16.1% of revenue, compared to GAAP operating income of $135.6 million, or 17.1% of revenue in 2024.
•Non-GAAP operating income was $234.9 million, or 24.7% of revenue, compared to non-GAAP operating income of $199.8 million, or 25.2% of revenue, in 2024.
•Net cash provided by operating activities was $242.1 million, or 25.5% of revenue, compared to $188.2 million, or 23.7% of revenue, in 2024.
We monitor the key business metric set forth below to help us evaluate our business, identify trends affecting our business, formulate business plans, and make strategic decisions.

Property management units under management. We believe that our ability to increase the number of property management units under management is an indicator of our market penetration, growth, and potential future business opportunities. We define property management units under management as active or committed units under management at the period end date. We had 9.4 million and 8.7 million property management units under management, as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

We have historically experienced seasonality in our Value Added Services revenue due to seasonally higher leasing activities in the second quarter. Specifically, higher tenant applications in the second quarter typically result in increased use by our property management customers of our tenant screening services and, in the third quarter once resident move-ins have occurred, higher demand for our risk mitigation services. Because of the seasonality in our Value Added Services, we typically experience a sequential increase in revenue in the first, second, and third quarters and a sequential decline in revenue in the fourth quarter. Moreover, if macroeconomic factors in a given fiscal year impact tenant behavior, our product portfolio mix, or the adoption rate of our other less seasonally impacted Value Added Services, the effect that seasonal factors have on our revenue may be exacerbated. Although these seasonal factors are common in the real estate industry, historical patterns should not be considered a reliable indicator of our future sales activity or performance.

Our Subscription Services and certain of our Value Added Services are offered on a subscription basis. The subscription fees for our Subscription Services vary by property type and are designed to scale with the size of our customers' businesses. We recognize revenue for subscription-based services on a straight-line basis over the contract term beginning on the date that our service is made available. We generally invoice monthly or, to a lesser extent, annually in advance of a subscription period.

We also offer certain Value Added Services, which are not covered by our subscription fees, on a per-use basis. Usage-based fees are charged either as a percentage of the transaction amount (e.g., for certain of our electronic payment services) or on a flat fee per transaction basis, generally with no minimum usage commitments (e.g., for our tenant screening and risk mitigation services). We recognize revenue for usage-based services in the period the service is rendered. Our payments services fees are recorded gross of any interchange and payment processing related fees. We generally invoice our usage-based services on a monthly basis or collect the fee at the time of service. A significant majority of our Value Added Services revenue comes from the use of our electronic payment services, tenant screening services, and risk mitigation services.

headings: 本公司業務與成長策略
paragraphs: 除非本年度報告另有說明，否則 herein 所提及的 "AppFolio," "we," "us," 和 "our" 均指 AppFolio, Inc. 及其合併子公司。

AppFolio 於 2006 年成立，是一家科技領導者，推動房地產業的未來。我們提供一個基於雲端的平台，即 AppFolio 平台，供客戶運作其業務。我們的主要客戶為管理多種類型不動產的不動產管理公司，包括單戶住宅、多戶住宅、經濟住宅、商業不動產、學生宿舍及社區協會。我們協助客戶在日益相互連結且成長中的業務生態系統中，處理其相關利害關係人，包括不動產管理員、不動產投資者、潛在租戶、租戶及供應商。我們也提供與不動產生命週期中關鍵交易相關的重要功能，包括篩選潛在租戶、發送與接收付款，以及提供與保險相關的風險緩衝服務。我們的服務使客戶能夠連結社區、提高運營效率、提供卓越的客戶體驗，並改善財務與運營表現。我們相信以客戶為中心的文化能帶來長期的客戶留存，進而實現我們的長期成功。

我們的使命是建立一個房地產業進行商業活動的平台。AppFolio 平台設計用以為不動產管理生態系統中的各產業利害關係人創造價值。這些利害關係人包括不動產管理員、不動產所有者及投資者、租戶及供應商。我們的以績效為導向的平台為 (i) 一個系統，用以集中並儲存所有關鍵運營資訊， (ii) 一個系統，用以自動化複雜的作業流程同時提供改善的結果，以及 (iii) 一個系統，用以推動生態系統內的價值與收入。

AppFolio 平台建立在一個統一的架構上，設計為客戶運營與財務資料的單一安全系統。此平台基礎提供即時的商業智慧與會計功能，同時維護資料完整性。在這個基礎之上，AppFolio Realm 將人工智慧，或 AI，直接整合至平台的作業流程中。透過如 Realm 這樣的功能，平台能自動化重複性高、體積大的任務，並促進運營效率。為進一步增強平台的靈活性，AppFolio Stack™ 市場場利用應用程式程式介面，或 APIs，協助客戶整合專門的第三方科技與服務。這個可擴展的生態系統讓客戶與合作夥伴能自訂其作業流程，並將專門的外部解決方案整合至統一的 AppFolio 環境中。
我們將產品與服務分為兩類，即訂閱服務與增值服務。訂閱服務與增值服務的使用與採用率通常在住宅不動產高於社區協會或商業不動產，這是因為住宅租賃生命週期有其獨特且複雜的需求。
AppFolio 平台主要透過三種訂閱方案提供：Core、Plus 與 Max。
•AppFolio Property Manager Core。AppFolio Property Manager Core 通常適合小型不動產管理公司，作為一個基本、全面、一體化的系統，以會計功能為中心，並包含有限的 Stack™ 整合功能。
•AppFolio Property Manager Plus。AppFolio Property Manager Plus 是為更複雜、成長中的不動產管理業務所設計，擴展 Core 方案的功能，加入經濟住宅與學生宿舍管理、進階會計、進階資料分析及唯讀 API 接入，並包含所有 Stack™ 整合功能。
•AppFolio Property Manager Max。AppFolio Property Manager Max 包含 Plus 的功能，並增加針對我們最大經營者設計的功能，提供如端到端租賃支援與內建租賃客戶關係管理，或 CRM，以及租賃信號等工具，並透過可讀取/寫入的 API 提供完整的資料庫存取。
The Subscription Services AppFolio 提供的服務透過 Core、Plus 和 Max Subscription Plans 提供，或可作為附加功能加入。主要提供的服務包括：
•會計與報告。AppFolio 提供財產管理會計軟體，作為單一資料庫系統，記錄所有交易。該軟體利用 AI 驅動的功能，如 Smart Budgeting、Bank Feed、Bill Approval Flows 和 Smart Bill Entry，以減少手動資料輸入並提高報告準確性。Performance Insights 管理儀錶板可協助進行資料驅動的戰略決策與高效的財務管理。

•行銷與租賃。行銷與租賃工具旨在協助客戶最大化使用率、維持租賃管道，並管理完整的租賃流程。我們的 Realm Leasing Performer 藉由 AI 自動化潛在客戶互動，包括潛在客戶篩選、資料收集與看屋排程。這些功能與我們的租賃 CRM 系統整合，提供集中化的端到端租賃管理與轉換追蹤。針對資產組合最佳化，我們的 Leasing Signals 會根據客戶獨特的定價策略，協助客戶做出定價決策，並根據公開資料提供可解釋的定價建議。

•維護。平台透過自動化與線上維護流程提供不動產維護工具。我們的 Realm Maintenance Performer 利用 AI 自動化服務請求的接收與分級處理。此工具可促進與住戶的即時多語種溝通，並自動產生優先級工作單。此自動化設計用以減少回應時間，並簡化維護問題的解決流程。我們的 Unit Turn Board 讓客戶可追蹤與管理準備單位以供新租賃所需的任務，目標為縮短空置期並最佳化租金收入。
•溝通與服務。AppFolio 提供現代化的溝通工具，以簡化客戶服務、維持營運，並為住戶、不動產所有者與投資者創造順暢的體驗。我們的 Realm Messages 將文字與電子郵件溝通整合至集中信箱。此功能讓客戶可在平台的核心流程中管理住戶對應，設計用以提升紀錄管理與回應效率。

•總管理的不動產管理單位數較 2024 年成長 8%，達 940 萬單位。
•營業收入較 2024 年成長 20%，達 9.508 億美元。
•GAAP 操作獲利為 1.529 億美元，佔營業收入的 16.1%，較 2024 年 GAAP 操作獲利 1.356 億美元，佔營業收入的 17.1%。
•非 GAAP 操作獲利為 2.349 億美元，佔營業收入的 24.7%，較 2024 年非 GAAP 操作獲利 1.998 億美元，佔營業收入的 25.2%。
•營運活動所產生之現金流入為2.421億美元，佔營業收入的25.5%，與2024年1.882億美元，佔營業收入的23.7%相比。
我們監測下列關鍵業務指標，以協助我們評估業務、識別影響業務的趨勢、制定業務計畫，並做出戰略決策。
我們管理的不動產管理單位數。我們認為，我們增加管理的不動產管理單位數的能力，是我們市場滲透率、成長與未來潛在業務機會的指標。我們將管理的不動產管理單位數定義為截至財務報表期間結束日為止，處於活躍或承諾管理狀態的單位數。截至2025年12月31日，我們管理的不動產管理單位數為940萬，截至2024年12月3月，為870萬。

我們歷來在附加價值服務收入中經歷季節性變動，這是因為第二季租賃活動較為活躍。具體而言，第二季較高的租戶申請通常導致我們的不動產管理客戶增加使用我們的租戶篩選服務，而在第三季居民入住房間後，對我們的風險緩衝服務需求也會增加。由於我們附加價值服務的季節性變動，我們通常會在第一、第二及第三季出現收入的連續增長，而在第四季出現收入的連續下降。此外，若某會計年度的總體經濟因素影響租戶行為、我們的產品組合結構，或我們其他較不受季節影響的附加價值服務的採用率，季節性因素對我們收入的影響可能會更加顯著。雖然這些季節性因素在不動產產業中相當常見，但歷史模式不應被視為我們未來銷售活動或表現的可靠指標。
我們的訂閱服務與部分附加價值服務是以訂閱方式提供的。我們訂閱服務的訂閱費用因不動產類型而異，並設計為與客戶企業規模相匹配。我們在合約期間內，按直線法確認訂閱服務的收入，自服務可供使用之日開始計算。我們通常每月開立發票，或在較少的情況下，於訂閱期間開始前每年開立發票。

我們也提供某些附加價值服務，這些服務不包含在我們的訂閱費用中，而是按使用量計費。使用量計費的費用通常以交易金額的百分比計算（例如，我們的部分電子付款服務），或以每筆交易固定費用計算，通常無最低使用量承諾（例如，我們的租戶篩選與風險緩衝服務）。我們在服務提供當期確認使用量計費服務的收入。我們的付款服務費用以扣除任何交換費及付款處理相關費用後的淨額記錄。我們通常每月開立發票，或在服務時點收取費用。我們附加價值服務收入的絕大多數來自我們的電子付款服務、租戶篩選服務與風險緩衝服務的使用。

headings: 與我們產品及服務相關的風險
若我們被發現違反適用於我們產品及服務的法律要求，將可能對我們的業務及營運結果產生負面影響。
我們在電子支付服務業務中面臨的風險，可能對我們的業務及/或營運結果產生負面影響。
支付卡網路或銀行費用、規則或作業方式的變更，可能對我們的業務造成損害。
我們在租客篩選服務業務中面臨的風險，可能對我們的業務及/或營運結果產生負面影響。
我們的以租客為導向的產品，例如 Resident Onboarding 及 Resident Onboarding Lift，使我們及我們的客戶面臨增加的監管審查及法律要求。
我們可能面臨反壟斷挑戰，這可能對我們的業務及營運結果造成損害。
若我們無法提供有效的客戶服務，可能損害我們與現有客戶的關係，並對我們吸引新客戶的能力及營運結果產生負面影響。
若本公司之不動產管理客戶停止要求為其單位提供保險保障，將可能對本公司營運成果造成損害。
本公司服務中人工智能（AI）之開發與整合，可能導致聲譽損害或法律責任，進而對本公司業務與營運成果產生不利影響。
若本公司無法確保其產品與服務能與其他科技同步進步，將可能導致競爭力下降，進而對營運成果造成損害。
若本公司無法確保其產品與服務能與其他科技相互操作，將可能導致競爭力下降，進而對營運成果造成損害。
本公司依賴第三方服務供應商來主機本公司平台，若該第三方服務中斷，將影響本公司營運，並可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
與網路安全及資料隱私相關之風險
隱私權法規可能導致額外成本，並降低本公司服務之需求。
與吸引及留住人才相關之風險
本公司企業文化已為我們的成功做出貢獻，若我們無法持續維持此文化，可能會失去該文化所培養的熱忱、創造力、團隊合作、專注力與創新力。
與我們產業相關之風險
目前所有營業收入均來自不動產業客戶之銷售，而影響該產業或其客戶之因素，也可能對我們造成不利影響。
本公司對市場潛力之估計面臨重大不確定性。
與擴張業務相關之風險
若本公司無法有效維持並提升品牌，將可能影響我們吸引新客戶之能力，並對業務與營運結果產生負面影響。
若本公司無法有效管理成長，成本與營運費用可能增加而收入未相應增加，將對營運結果造成不利影響。
若本公司無法準確預測並迅速回應快速演進之科技發展與客戶需求，將可能對產品需求及業務與營運結果造成損害。
我們參與一個高度競爭的市場，若我們無法有效競爭，本公司業務可能會受到損害。
若我們無法成功將產品與服務銷售至新市場，將可能影響本公司業務、財務狀況與營運成果。
本公司業務高度依賴現有客戶續訂訂閱服務並擴大使用我們的增值服務，若其中任何一者下降，可能會對本公司營運成果產生不利影響。
本公司管理業務以實現長遠成長，這可能與部分投資者的短暫期待不一致。
本公司收購其他公司或技術可能使我們面臨風險。
與智慧財產權相關的風險
未能保護我們的智慧財產權，包括我們的程式碼、專有技術與品牌，可能會削弱我們的競爭地位並損害本公司業務。
paragraphs: 投資本公司證券涉及風險。您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險，並配合本年度報告中包含的所有其他資訊，以及本公司其他向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交的檔，以評估本公司業務及/或投資本公司A類普通股的相關風險。若任何下列風險實際發生，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果、現金流量及前景造成重大且不利的影響。在此情況下，本公司A類普通股的交易價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。下列所描述的風險並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險。此外，本公司目前未知或認為不重要的其他風險，也可能影響本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果、現金流量及前景。

本公司業務活動受各項聯邦、州及地方法律與規範所規範。此外，本公司部分服務，例如租客篩選與風險緩衝服務，屬於高度規範或預期與其他高度規範活動結合使用。不利的法律、規範及行政或司法機關對法律與規範的解釋與適用，可能使本公司面臨訴訟或政府調查，並提高本公司營運成本，任何一項都可能對本公司營運結果造成不利影響。此外，本公司產品與服務的演進與擴張，可能使本公司面臨額外的規範風險與要求。例如，隨著本公司電子支付服務業務的發展，本公司可能直接受到管理資金傳輸與反洗錢法律的規範。規範要求因市場而異，且隨著本公司產品與服務的範圍與複雜度擴張，規範要求已逐漸增加。此外，聯邦與州立法機構及規範機關已表示他們重視租客權益。此關注可能導致新法律與規範的制定，這些法律與規範可能直接適用於本公司業務。本公司無法保證不會因違反法律或規範要求而受到罰款、刑事與民事訴訟或其他規範執法行動，或被要求調整營運作法以符合規範要求。
新興與持續演進的規範要求也可能影響客戶及其使用本公司產品與服務的意願與能力。例如，本公司持續監測聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）、消費者金融保護局（CFPB）及各州規範機關針對租客篩選的活動。新興或不確定的規範要求可能影響本公司提供或客戶使用某些服務的能力與意願，這可能影響本公司營運結果。

本公司定期接受規範機關對本公司服務的檢查、稽核與調查，包括與保險公司與機構及電子支付服務提供者的業務相關事項。這些檢查、稽核與調查機關通常擁有相當廣泛的裁量權，可發給、續發或吊銷許可與核准，可制定與解釋規則與規範，課以罰款與處罰，並採取執法行動。雖然本公司已於各業務領域實施各種程序、流程與控制措施，以符合適用法律與規範，但本公司無法保證不會因違反法律或規範要求而受到罰款、處罰或其他規範行動，或被要求調整營運作法以符合未來規範要求。若本公司被發現違反法律或規範要求，本公司可能面臨財務處罰、停止營運命令、強制產品變更或其他負擔，這可能對本公司業務（包括聲譽損害）及營運結果造成不利影響。

本公司電子支付服務業務協助客戶處理進出款的支付。這些支付透過本公司擔保清算銀行、經許可的資金傳輸機構、卡支付處理商及其他第三方電子支付服務提供者進行結算。針對這些服務提供者，本公司對其系統與流程的控制遠低於若本公司自行維護與運作這些系統與流程的情況。在某些情況下，對本公司業務至關重要的功能是由專屬第三方系統與軟體執行，而本公司無權存取。本公司通常也與這些服務提供者沒有長期契約。此外，本公司依賴有限數量的第三方電子支付服務提供者，且在某些情況下，對特定服務並未設有備用服務提供者。因此，這些服務提供者未能與本公司續約或履行契約義務並妥善執行，可能導致本公司營運出現重大中斷，並對本公司營運結果造成不利影響。
本公司將持續面臨與支付交易結算相關的風險，包括與預先資金及退款請求以及人為或處理錯誤相關的風險。用戶最終需履行資金交易的義務；然而，在有退貨或退款的情況下，本公司
